text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Negeri Sabah (Pemerluasan
dan Ubah Suaian Akta Kehadiran Wajib Pesalah-Pesalah 1954) 2012.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 16 September 2012.

Pemerluasan dan ubah suaian Akta ke Negeri Sabah

2. (1) Akta Kehadiran Wajib Pesalah-Pesalah 1954 (Akta 46/], yang discbut
"Akta yang diperluas" dalam Perintah ini, diperluas ke Negeri Sabah.

(2) Dalam pemakaiannya bagi Negeri Sabah, Akta yang diperluas diubah
suai mengikut cara yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

JADUAL
{Subperenggan 2(2))

Peruntukan Akta Kehadiran Wajib Pesalah-                  Ubah suaian
Pesalah 1954

Seksyen 3                          Gantikan perkataan "States of Peninsular
Malaysia" dengan perkataan "States of Peninsular
Malaysia and the State of Sabah".

Dibuat 27 Ogos 2012
[KDN.PDP(S) 03/22/3 Jld.2;,PN(PU?)H12/IV)

Dengan Titah Perintah,

Dato' Sri Dr. Att Hamsa
Setiausaha Jemaah Menteri

[Akan dibentangkan di Dewan Rakyat dan Dewan Negara menurut subseksyen
74(9) Akta Malaysia]

O
P.U. (A) 292.                                   6300

MALAYSIA ACT

STATE OF SABAH (EXTENSION AND MODIFICATION OF THE OFFENDERS
CamPuLsorY ATTENDANCE ACT 1954) Order 2012

In exercise of the powers conferred by section 74 of the Malaysia Act
[Act 26/1963), the Yang di-Pertuan Agong makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1, (1) This order may be cited as the State of Sabah (Extension and
Modification of the Offenders Compulsory Attendance Act 1954) Order

(2) This Order comes into operation on 16 September 2012.

Extension and modification of the Act to the State of Sabah

2. (1) The Offenders Compulsory Attendance Act 1954 [Act 461), which is
referred to as the "extended Act" in this Order, is extended to the State of
Sabah.

(2) In its application to the State of Sabah, the extended Act is modified
in the manner as set. out in the Schedule.
:  "SCHEDULE
[Subparagraph 2(2)]

Provisions of the Offenders Compulsory                     Modification
Attendance Act 1954

Section 3                                    Substitute for the words "States of Peninsular
Malaysia" the words "States of Peninsular
Malaysia and the State of Sabah".

Made 27 August 2012
[KDN.PDP(S) 03/22/3 Jid.2; PN(PU?)112/IV]

By Command,
Dato' Sri Dr. Att Hamsa

Secretary to the Cabinet

[To be laid before Dewan Rakyat and Dewan Negara pursuant to subsection
74(9) of the Malaysia Act]
